novel.justification: The condition consists of finitely many strict context-specific categorical contrasts. On every fixed double-triangular graph, the explicit diagonal-dominant family has local determinants \(\eta_{a,k,u}^{q-1}\), so the nonvanishing locus is a nonempty relatively open dense, full-measure subset of the positive categorical-table parameter space. Such contrasts can be checked in polytomous cognitive-diagnosis designs without pure children.
